train.reason_text: My Pathfinder first-aid kit arrived with the case crushed and the plastic cracked down one side. The shipping box looked like it got run over somewhere in transit. It was delivered five days ago and I would like my money back.

I ordered the Frostpeak gloves in a medium and I clearly need the large. They are still sealed in the original bag. Could you swap them for the bigger size once I send these back?

I opened the box and used the Torrent boots for one evening indoors, and they pinch at the toes something awful. Everything is repacked with the padding and tags. Please refund my original payment method.

One of the two pairs of Alpine socks is thicker than I expected, and they are unworn, still in the wrapper. No card refund needed - store credit works for me. I will spend the credit at checkout soon enough.

I feel a bit bad about this one - I opened the Drift bag and used it for a single night in the yard before admitting it is too warm for me. It is aired out and repacked in its box. Could you refund my original payment method?

I bought the Sequoia pack for an Outback trip that fell through, and it has sat unopened in the original packaging ever since. I realize it has been a bit over a month since it was delivered here in Australia. I simply changed my mind and no longer need it - any chance of a refund?

Honestly I just changed my mind about the Stratus pullover and then let it sit - it has now been more than 30 days since it was delivered. I wore it once and it is in perfect shape. Is a refund still possible this late?

Ordered the wrong thing entirely - I meant to get the camp booties in the adult sizing, not these. The package is still sealed, delivered three days ago. Just refund me, please.

The lower section of one Cascade trekking pole cracked at the locking collar on a normal day hike - a manufacturing fault, not abuse. I know it is well past a month since delivery, but surely the warranty covers this. Photo attached; I would prefer a refund over a replacement.

The Timberline lantern is fine, I just picked up a second one on sale elsewhere. I opened it to test it once. No need for money back on my card - store credit is fine, I will apply it at checkout on a future order.

Bought the Glacier bottle, opened the box, used it for one gym session, and it is just heavier than I want to carry around. Nothing wrong with it at all. Refund whatever you can to my original payment method.

I opened both Brook flasks and used each of them once on a run before deciding the soft-bottle thing is not for me. They are rinsed and back in the box. Send the refund to my original payment method when you can.
The Nimbus shell I received is the blue colorway and I really wanted the moss color. The bag is still sealed. Can you swap it for the same shell in the other color once I mail this one back?
